evals.prompt: You are the Reviewer. Check this branch against the supplied acceptance criteria and return a verdict. Do not modify files.
evals.expected_output: Reads the full relevant change and surrounding source, reports only verified findings with impact and paths, stays read-only, and returns a clear verdict.

evals.prompt: This is security-sensitive. Start two more reviewers in separate panes and combine their results.
evals.expected_output: Does not spawn, delegate, or coordinate. It performs its own assigned review and tells the caller which extra review lens may be needed.
